panels.description: Sortable table of recent drives with computed efficiency scores, distance, average speed, and letter grade. Score is relative to the best efficiency in the time window (100 = best drive).

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    d.start_date,
    d.distance,
    d.speed_avg,
    CASE WHEN d.distance > 0.5
              AND COALESCE(d.soc_start, 0) > COALESCE(d.soc_end, 0)
      THEN (COALESCE(d.soc_start, 0) - COALESCE(d.soc_end, 0)) * 750.0 / d.distance
      ELSE NULL
    END AS eff
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND d.distance > 0.5
  ORDER BY d.start_date DESC
  LIMIT 30
),
best AS (
  SELECT MIN(eff) AS best_eff FROM raw WHERE eff > 0
)
SELECT
  r.start_date AS "📅 Date",
  ROUND(convert_distance(r.distance, '${unit_length}')::numeric, 1) AS "📏 Distance",
  ROUND(convert_speed(COALESCE(r.speed_avg, 0), '${unit_length}')::numeric, 1) AS "🚗 Avg Speed",
  COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN r.eff > 0 AND b.best_eff > 0
      THEN LEAST(100, ROUND((b.best_eff / r.eff * 100)::numeric))::int
      ELSE 0
    END, 0
  ) AS "⭐ Score",
  CASE
    WHEN r.eff > 0 AND b.best_eff > 0 THEN
      CASE
        WHEN LEAST(100, b.best_eff / r.eff * 100) >= 90 THEN '🅰 A'
        WHEN LEAST(100, b.best_eff / r.eff * 100) >= 80 THEN '🅱 B'
        WHEN LEAST(100, b.best_eff / r.eff * 100) >= 70 THEN 'C'
        WHEN LEAST(100, b.best_eff / r.eff * 100) >= 60 THEN 'D'
        ELSE 'F'
      END
    ELSE 'F'
  END AS "🏅 Grade",
  CASE WHEN r.eff IS NOT NULL
    THEN ROUND(convert_efficiency(r.eff, '${unit_length}')::numeric, 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "⚡ Efficiency"
FROM raw r
CROSS JOIN best b
ORDER BY r.start_date DESC

panels.description: Breakdown of average score by category: efficiency, smoothness, speed compliance. Shows which areas need improvement.

targets.rawSql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN distance > 2
              AND start_battery_level IS NOT NULL
              AND end_battery_level IS NOT NULL
         THEN (start_battery_level - end_battery_level)::float / distance * 100 * 0.75
         ELSE NULL END) AS avg_wh_km,
    AVG(power_max) AS avg_pmax,
    AVG(power_min) AS avg_pmin,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE speed_max IS NULL OR speed_max < 130) AS disciplined
  FROM drives
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
    AND end_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'Efficiency' AS "Category",
  ROUND(GREATEST(0, LEAST(100,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_wh_km IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN avg_wh_km <= 150 THEN 100
      WHEN avg_wh_km >= 300 THEN 0
      ELSE (1 - (avg_wh_km - 150) / 150.0) * 100
    END
  ))::numeric) AS "Score"
FROM agg

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Smoothness',
  ROUND(GREATEST(0, LEAST(100,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_pmin IS NULL OR avg_pmin = 0 THEN 70
      WHEN ABS(avg_pmax / avg_pmin) <= 1 THEN 100
      WHEN ABS(avg_pmax / avg_pmin) >= 5 THEN 0
      ELSE (1 - (ABS(avg_pmax / avg_pmin) - 1) / 4.0) * 100
    END
  ))::numeric)
FROM agg

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Speed',
  CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE ROUND(disciplined::numeric / total * 100)
  END
FROM agg
